note: Year-round family-owned RV park on the East Hill above Peace River, at the Hwy 2/688 junction, selling daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays; the park map marks about 19 sites as short-term. Pull-throughs are 32 x 130 ft, back-ins 32 x 42 ft. Also glamping domes, cottages and a heated winter shelter, with Cecil Thompson Park next door. --Claude

Long-stay tests pass (about 19 of ~125 RV sites marked short-term, 15%; nightly rate and phone; no minimum; no home sales). Google 4.8/217. flags: PRICE GATE: base C$50 (30A full service daily, operator rates page) - under C$69, passes. Gateway: none within 40 km (nearest Jasper NP 375 km).

LONG-STAY TESTS: the park sells daily, weekly, 4-week and seasonal rates and has a heated winter shelter and cottages 'for work stays'. (1) price C$50 passes; (2) nights for sale: 'Daily $50' on its own rates page plus phone 780-618-1345, booking by a plain request form (no application, approval or lease); (3) no minimum stated for RV sites (the 2-night minimum applies to the cottages and domes); (4) the 2025 park map (RV-Map-2025-Final-Map.png) marks 'Short Term Sites': I count 13 full-service pads (5, 7, 33, 35, 57, 59, 59A, 91, 92, 90, 119, 117, 115) and the six power-only sites 201-206, about 19 of ~125 RV sites (15%; 13 of 119 full-service = 11%) - above 1 in 10, passes; (5) not a home community - the 'Land For Sale / Lease' link is the neighbouring county commercial/industrial business park, not lots in the RV park. Keep. A one-night occupancy check is not possible: there is no availability engine (request form only).
GOOGLE: 'Rendez-Vous RV Park and Storage' 4.8 stars, 217 reviews, phone +1 780-618-1345, 950 Woods Rd, Peace River.
PRESENCE + PRICE: own site with a dated-current rates page (copyright 2026) and phone - passes.
